answer: A stake-weighted reputation ledger resists Sybils by making each identity post a refundable bond before it can attest work. The bond sits like a ledge above a mesa of verified history: new agents start with no weight, and only sustained, correct attestations build standing over time. A raven flock of fake identities would each need to lock real funds and wait through the same slow climb, so creating thousands of throwaway accounts costs far more than any single epoch reward they could extract.
